items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: And Tab Lyon Kato was playing with him too.

ctx.x: Who was in that band with him? Do you remember the guy?

No, I only know him. I know the bass player, but I can't call his name. He's dead too. And Tab Lyon Kato was playing with him too. Who? Little Kato. Not Tab. Tab was a piano player. Tab played bass violin too. You know him?
No, Tab? Yeah. No, I didn't know him.

items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I got my own band. And who was in that? Oh, I can't call all the fellas then. Dude Gabriel on clarinet, Keto on the drum, Charlie Moore on the banjo. And who else? A fella from up in Corbin, he used to play bass. I forgot his name. I had Percy on the drum.

ctx.x: And then after you left the Bulls, who did you go with?

I got my own band. And who was in that? Oh, I can't call all the fellas then. Dude Gabriel on clarinet, Keto on the drum, Charlie Moore on the banjo. And who else? A fella from up in Corbin, he used to play bass. I forgot his name. I had Percy on the drum.
